'''Pokémon Adventures: The Seafoam Encounter''' is the 27th monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Mato]]. It contains chapters 23, 24, and 25 of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of {{PAV|5}}. As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
